name: Margoz

narrative.details:
One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption.  He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.

Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz.  He is wise and his council is valued.

He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.

Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, adventurer, I still want you to crush those cultists!
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome, adventurer. Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in Durotar.

You are a Champion of growing skill and renown.

Stay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.

quests.name: Report to Orgnil
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

quests.name: Dark Storms
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

quests.name: Skull Rock
quests.objectiveText: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock. Bring them to Margoz at his camp.

quests.name: Neeru Fireblade
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Ak'Zeloth
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ak'Zeloth in the Barrens.
